homepage.hero.tagline.message: A hub of battle-tested solutions for enterprise-grade AI applications

homepage.feature.rag.desc.message: Auto-import and smart preprocessing of multi-format documents, hybrid vector + full-text retrieval with re-ranking for accurate, traceable multi-turn Q&A.

homepage.feature.workflow.desc.message: Drag-and-drop low-code design with 25+ built-in nodes for loops, parallelism and branching — orchestrate complex logic without writing code.

homepage.feature.agent.desc.message: Function Calling and autonomous agent decisions, combining tools, skills and knowledge bases, with built-in bidirectional MCP to connect external systems.

homepage.highlights.label.description: Badge label above the highlights section heading

homepage.highlights.desc.message: FastGPT brings knowledge bases, workflows and AI agents together, so teams can ship enterprise-grade AI apps without deep AI expertise.

homepage.highlights.rag.desc.message: Auto-import and smart preprocessing of multi-format documents with hybrid vector + full-text retrieval, accurate and traceable.

homepage.highlights.workflow.desc.message: Drag-and-drop low-code orchestration with 25+ built-in nodes for loops, parallelism and branching.

homepage.highlights.agent.desc.message: Function Calling with autonomous decisions, plus bidirectional MCP to connect external tools and systems.

homepage.highlights.models.desc.message: A unified AI Proxy gateway connecting ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, ERNIE and other mainstream models.

homepage.highlights.security.desc.message: ABAC + RBAC resource-level permissions with team collaboration and multi-channel publishing.

homepage.highlights.deploy.desc.message: One-click private deployment via Docker Compose, plus a fully managed SaaS cloud option.

homepage.testimonials.title.message: Don't take our word for it

homepage.testimonials.desc.message: FastGPT has helped many teams put AI to work across knowledge bases, customer service and data analysis.

homepage.testimonials.q1.message: We imported hundreds of product documents into FastGPT; customer inquiry responses went from hours to seconds, and answers trace back to the source.

homepage.testimonials.q2.message: FastGPT's hybrid retrieval with re-ranking made answers much more precise — internal policy Q&A no longer misses the point.

homepage.testimonials.q3.message: The FastGPT customer-service bot is online 24/7, resolving common issues automatically while agents handle only complex tickets.

homepage.testimonials.q4.message: With human hand-off built into the workflow, complex issues transfer seamlessly and the customer experience improved a lot.

homepage.testimonials.q5.message: Once FastGPT connected to our database, business users could query data and build charts in natural language — analysis is much faster.

homepage.testimonials.q6.message: Drag-and-drop workflows chained multi-document summarization and batch translation, removing a lot of repetitive work.
